title: The Defrocked Priest
text: A priest stripped of his robes begs at the Court's gate, the shaved patch on his head grown out ragged. He still blesses the people who kick him. He knows how the Court is run, he whispers, every bribe and every body, for a price.

options.label: Pay him for the Court's secrets, and hope he is as desperate as he looks.

outcomes.text: He shows you a back way through the Court, past every guard.
He takes the money and runs. His laugh is the most honest thing about him.

options.label: The kindest gives him bread instead, as a priest once might have done.

outcomes.text: Weeping, he eats, then tells you everything: every bribe and every body.

options.label: Turn him over to the Court, and buy your passage with his hide.

outcomes.text: The Court thanks you and lets you pass. As they drag him off, you hear him blessing them.
